resolved_source_locations.conclusion: A mathematics theory package is a tuple T = (Z,\ f,\ Sigma_f,\ E,\ D) where: Z is a carrier of discrete protocol objects at a chosen stage (e.g.\ grid functions, truncated sums/products, finite compositions, Cauchy sequences of rationals). f:Z→ X is a lens (a coarse description map). The induced definability structure Sigma_f is the family of predicates on Z that are visible through f (equivalently: constant on fibers of f ). E: V→ V is a completion/packaging endomap on a chosen description space V associated to Z (often idempotent or approximately idempotent in a specified norm). The fixed points of E are the internally complete objects recognized by the theory at the chosen scale. D is a defect ledger: a designated family of nonnegative diagnostics (error bounds, residual norms, route mismatch statistics) together with a monotonicity principle under refinement/coarsening. In this mathematics instantiation, D records feasibility (stability under refinement), not a thermodynamic arrow-of-time.
